query: INSERT INTO social_media_streamer_settings (streamer_login, twitch_user_id, approval_mode, timezone, updated_by) SELECT twitch_login, twitch_user_id, $2, $3, 'auto_default' FROM twitch_streamers WHERE twitch_user_id = $1 ON CONFLICT (twitch_user_id) WHERE twitch_user_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
